messages:
devon_acme: Hey team — urgent billing question. Our invoice inv_2026_03_10 shows a $5,120 charge but our dashboard usage for that day is ~72k tokens. Can someone explain why tokens on the invoice are ~1.2M? request_id=req_4f2a9c
alex_support: Sorry about that, devon — we’ll investigate. Can you paste the account id and a link to the invoice? Also any sample logs (request ids) you have would help.
devon_acme: Account: acct_ACME_77. Invoice link: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/inv_2026_03_10
Posting a short log snippet — looks like our client retried a batch and I see the same request id multiple times:
```
2026-03-10T02:12:03Z req=req_4f2a9c tokens=12000 status=200
2026-03-10T02:12:05Z req=req_4f2a9c tokens=12000 status=200
2026-03-10T02:12:08Z req=req_9b1d2a tokens=800 status=200
```
We didn't send that many unique requests.
alex_support: Thanks. Pinging @billing-bot and @ivan_eng to re-evaluate metering events and see if duplicated events were recorded on our side. :eyes:
billing-bot: Created ticket FNC-1234 for metering recount. Initial recount started. ETA ~2h.
ivan_eng: I pulled the usage event stream for acct_ACME_77. I can see duplicated usage events matching req_4f2a9c — looks like our realtime ingestion emitted two usage events when the websocket reconnect occurred and the client resent the payload. Repro steps I used:
1) open websocket to /v1/streams
2) send payload with no idempotency header
3) disconnect immediately and reconnect, replay payload
Result: two usage events emitted for same logical request.
Sample ingestion log:
```
ingest: event_id=evt_aa11 req=req_4f2a9c tokens=12000
ingest: event_id=evt_aa12 req=req_4f2a9c tokens=12000
```
Root cause: missing dedupe on request_id/idempotency_token in the realtime ingestion path. I'll open a PR to dedupe by X-Idempotency-Key and by request_id when present. Will include a backfill script to detect duplicates in last 72h.
maria_fin: Thanks Ivan. Finance needs the recount delta breakdown and a revrec note we can attach to the ledger. Please provide:
- original invoiced amount: $5,120
- recounted billable tokens: 72,400 (matches dashboard)
- overbilled tokens: 1,127,600 -> overcharged amount (calculated) $5,120 (matches customer claim)
Draft revrec note suggestion: "Revenue adjustment: Duplicate metering events due to realtime ingestion replay bug causing double-counting of tokens for acct_ACME_77 on 2026-03-10. Full customer credit issued."
alex_support: Proposed customer action: issue full credit of $5,120 to acct_ACME_77 as account credit and adjust invoice. Confirm with finance.
maria_fin: Confirmed — issue full credit and apply accounting adjustment. Revrec reason code: MR-DEDUP-2026-03. GL note: Reduce recognized revenue and post contra-revenue for period Mar 2026. Please include ticket FNC-1234 on the note.
billing-bot: Refund action complete. Credit id cr_7890 created for acct_ACME_77 for $5,120. Invoice inv_2026_03_10 adjusted and marked partially refunded. Refund reference: REF-2026-03-FNC1234.
devon_acme: I see the credit applied on our console, thanks. Can you confirm this will appear on our next statement? :thumbsup:
alex_support: Yes — the credit is applied to the account balance and will be reflected on the next statement. We also attached the revrec note to the ledger (MR-DEDUP-2026-03) and linked the ticket.
ivan_eng: PR merged: redwood/realtime#451 dedupe by idempotency_key & request_id. Deploy scheduled to canary tonight. Commit: 9b7c4d2. Backfill script: tools/metering/dedupe_backfill.py created to scan last 7 days for duplicates; to be run after canary.
alex_support: Follow-ups: (1) run backfill and produce final recount CSV for finance, (2) confirm no other accounts affected in same time window, (3) close FNC-1234 after finance confirms ledger entries.
maria_fin: Will run accounting entry tomorrow morning and close once GL is posted. Please attach recount CSV to FNC-1234.
devon_acme: Really appreciate the quick turnaround. Please keep me posted if you find any related issues. :pray:
replay-bot: Note: monitored websocket replay rate spiked at 02:11-02:15 UTC; alert threshold triggered. Related alerts created: ALERT-WS-REPLAY-2026-03-10.
alex_support: Closing loop here — credit issued and fix merged. Reopen if anything else comes up. :white_check_mark:
